full_judgment: LATIFUR RAHMAN. J :- The petitioner filed Arbitration Miscellaneous case No. 49 of 1994 under section 20 of the Arbitration Act before the subordinate Judge, First court, Dhaka where in he prayed for an ad-interim injunction under Rule 4 of the second schedule read with section 41 of the Arbitration Act restraining the respondent from handling cash receipt of the Ittefaq Group of publications Ltd. except withdrawal from the Bank account of the company. The said application for adinterim injunction was rejected by the trial Court by its order dated 11.4.95. Against that Judgment and order the petitioner filed First Miscellaneous Appeal No. 79 of 1995 with civil Rule No. 186 (FM)/95 and A Division Bench of the High Court Division dismissed the Appeal refusing to grant injunction: The petitioner being aggrieved by the impugned judgment has filed this leave petition before us.
